title: Embed mnemonic prompts in reading
principle: If lasting understanding matters, put retrieval prompts in the medium itself—so memory practice is part of reading, not a separate chore.
procedure: Identify the few ideas that must stick.
Write retrieval prompts (not recognition quizzes) near those ideas.
Schedule lightweight revisit affordances in the UI if possible.
Avoid prompt spam—only where forgetting is costly.
Measure whether people remember, not whether they scrolled.
